title: A bounded context is retired by retire without a concept, as an entry of its own kind
situation: A bounded context is retired whole when the design drops it, its history kept, but the journal can retire only a concept, so a context the design no longer has, such as the misnamed corpus context, stays in every reading with no concepts (record-speaks-the-pattern).
decision: (1) retire takes its concept optionally; without one it retires the bounded context named, with the reason, as an entry of its own kind, retire-context: the context, the reason, and the current descriptions it supersedes. A runtime that predates it reads it past (0297). It is refused for a context the journal does not have, one already retired, and a delivered one. (2) A retired context, its concepts with it, is shown by no reading of the design: state, design and leakage leave it out, and decisions lists its decisions only when history is asked for. (3) Its history stays readable: the context's own history lists the retirement with its reason after its descriptions, and each of its concepts' history reads as before. (4) define, supersede, retire and decide naming a retired context are refused, naming the remedy: bring it back with the context verb and a reason. context with a reason brings it back by a new description superseding the retirement, subject and relation carried, where left out, from the description the retirement superseded; its concepts and decisions then read as they stood. accept and deprecate, which name a decision, are not refused. (5) A retired context takes no delivered context's place: where its identity is a delivered context's, the delivered one is shown again. (6) Closing the books carries nothing of a retired context: no description, concept or decision opens; all stay in the closed period.
consequences: A context the design drops leaves every reading of the design and can no longer be recorded into, its history kept until the books close. One builder; review Ask.
